newsitem.title: USA: IPO FILING-US Liquids files 1.5 mln shrs.
newsitem.headline: IPO FILING-US Liquids files 1.5 mln shrs.

text.p: US Liquids Inc filed Thursday with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission an initial public offering of up to 1.5 million shares it expects to sell for between $8.50 and $10.50 each.
Underwriters for the offering, Van Kasper & Co and Sanders Morris Mundy, have an over-allotment option on up to 225,000 shares.
The Houston-based company, which manages non-hazardous commercial waste, said proceeds from the sale will be used to repay debt, fund capital expenditures and for other corporate needs.
After the offering, the company will have 6,738,875 shares outstanding.
